content:
Here are the findings regarding free Gemini Advanced (Google One AI Premium / Google AI Pro) subscriptions bundled with hardware and other promotions in 2026:

### 1. Chromebook Plus Hardware Offers
*   **Offer:** 12 months free of the Google AI Pro plan (which includes Gemini Advanced and typically 2TB-5TB of cloud storage).
*   **Eligibility:** Applies to new purchases of **Chromebook Plus** devices. 
*   **Standard Chromebooks:** Standard (non-Plus) Chromebooks may be eligible for a **3-month trial**.
*   **How to claim:** Redeem via the [Chromebook Perks page](https://www.google.com/chromebook/perks/) (from the device) by opening the Chromebook Perks app or Gemini app on the device.

### 2. Google Pixel Hardware Offers
*   **Pixel 10 Pro Series (12 Months):** The Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, and Pixel 10 Pro Fold include a **12-month free trial** of Gemini Advanced (Google One AI Premium). 
    *   *Note:* The redemption deadline for this 12-month offer is **October 31, 2026**.
*   **Pixel 11 Pro Series (6 Months):** For the newly released (Aug 2026) Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, the bundled free trial has been reduced to **6 months** of the Google AI Pro plan. The base model Pixel 11 does not qualify.
*   **How to claim:** Open the Google One or Gemini app on the eligible Pixel device and look for the promotional banner or check the "Benefits" tab.

### 3. Student Promotion (Launched August 2026)
While not strictly a hardware bundle, this is currently the most accessible 12-month promotion available:
*   **Offer:** Eligible college students can claim **one year of a paid Gemini plan at no cost**.
*   **Details:** US students receive 1 year of **Google AI Pro** (includes Gemini Advanced). Students in 140+ other countries receive 1 year of **Google AI Plus**. 
*   **How to claim:** Eligible students can verify their student status and claim the offer at the official Gemini student hub: [gemini.google.com/students](https://gemini.google.com/students).

### Important Restrictions
*   These hardware-bundled offers are generally for *new* customers of the Google One AI Premium/Pro service. If a user is currently subscribed to or has previously trialed Gemini Advanced on their Google Account, they may be ineligible to redeem the hardware perk.
*   The trials auto-renew into paid subscriptions after the 12-month or 6-month period ends, so users should cancel before the renewal date to avoid charges.
